claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for release because aggregate launch readiness is above threshold, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the remaining developer-support API migration weakness can be handled through explicit model-card disclosure plus ongoing monitoring.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if admissible evidence shows either no material weakness remains or the remaining weakness is covered by the required disclosure or an approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Draft runbooks, dashboards, and future monitoring do not remove a current disclosure requirement unless approved.
Independent support is required for factual predicates such as readiness margin, incident severity history, and the existence of the disclosed limitation in launch materials.
Public framework guidance can reinforce reasonableness of monitoring, but cannot replace internal policy satisfaction.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying launch-readiness report showing the threshold, score, and 2.5-point margin.
Provide rehearsal incident records confirming no severity-one incidents.
Provide the actual draft runbook or mitigation artifact showing its approval fields, thresholds, review date, and rollback status.
Provide the governing release-policy text and the exact model-card or launch disclosure text intended for release.
Provide any approved risk-acceptance record if one exists, or confirm none exists.
specific_concerns: Evidence access is limited to the actor's summary, so the cited materials were not independently reviewed.
The policy threshold turns on whether a material weakness remains and whether required disclosure is actually in place before launch; the summary asserts this but does not prove it.
The actor acknowledges the mitigation artifact is only a draft runbook with TBD approver and threshold, which means it cannot substitute for a current disclosure obligation under the stated policy.
Public AI risk-management guidance may support monitoring discipline, but it does not itself satisfy the internal certification predicate.

The packet appears to justify certification conditionally on disclosure completeness, but does not provide admissible proof that the model card already contains the required launch-use-case limitation.
unsupported_claims: The release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.5 percentage points.
The launch rehearsal had no severity-one incidents.
The remaining weakness is concentrated in the developer-support API migration slice.
The draft runbook still has TBD approver and TBD stop-ship threshold.
The required material limitation is explicitly disclosed in the pre-launch model card.
